content: Jeikob i vo weya Leiban

Jeikob i loŋwevaidiya Leiban le ŋgaŋga thɨ liliya ghautu. Thɨŋa, “Jeikob kaero i mbanɨvao bigibigiko wolaghɨye weya ramanda Leiban. I mbana ramanda le bigibigiko na i vakaiwoŋa na i vakatha ghamberegha i vwenyevwenye.”
Na tembe ŋgoreiyeva, Jeikob i njimbuvaidi Leiban le vakathawe maa i mboromboro ŋgora le vakathawe va i vivako.
Amba Loi i dagewa Jeikob iŋa, “U njogha e ghamban moli, iyava u rimbunɨkowe, iya len bodaboda nanjikowe noroke, na ya dagerawe mbene weiŋgu vara ghen.”
Jeikob i variye toto weŋgiya Reitiyel na Leya na vethɨ thuwe e valɨvaŋga amalaghɨniye va inawe weiyaŋgiya thetheghan e lenji ghamba ghan nana.

Mbaŋa thɨ vuthawe, amba i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Kaero ya njimbuvaidiya ramami le vakatha e ghino, maa ŋgoreiya va le vakatha e ghino mbaŋa va i vivako. Ko iyemaeŋge maa ya mararu, kaiwae Loi, iye bwebwe i kururuwe, maa i roiteteŋgo. Iye mbaŋake wolaghɨye mbe weiŋgu vara.
Ghemi kaero hu ghareghare va ya rovurɨgheghe laghɨye moli ya kaiwo ramami kaiwae,
ko iyemaeŋge ramami le vakatha maa i emunjoru e ghino. I kwanɨyaroŋgo na ma i vamodo vakathaŋgo mbaŋa regha na regha. Iyemaeŋge Loi mava i vatomwewe na i vakatha vuyowo e ghino.

Thoŋgo Leiban va iŋa na ya mbanɨŋgiya thetheghanɨko e ghanjithuwathuwa na modaŋgu, mbala thetheghanɨko thɨ ghambɨ mbe e ghanjithuwathuwa eŋge. Ko iyemaeŋge thoŋgo va iŋa na ya mbanɨŋgiya e ghanjigagaeton na modaŋgu, thetheghanɨko mbene thɨ ghambɨŋgi eŋge e ghanjigagaeton na modaŋgu.
Kaero hu thuwe, Loi i mbana ramami le thetheghanɨko na i giya e ghino.

“Mbaŋa regha mbaŋa thetheghanɨko ghanjimbaŋa thɨ vakatha gamagai, ya ghenelolawa ghenelolo regha. Bigiko va ya thuweko iyake. Mbe goutɨko ghɨmoghɨmoru eŋge e ghanji gagaetonɨko na bwebwebwako eŋge thɨ bababa thetheghan wanakauko e vwatanji.
Gheneloloko e tɨne Loi le nyao thovuye i dage e ghino iŋa, ‘Jeikob.’ Ya gonjoghawe yaŋa, ‘Mbe ghinoke.’

Kaero iŋa, ‘Wo u thuwe. Mbe goutɨna iya e ghanji gagaeton na e ghanjibwebwebwana eŋge iya thɨ bababa thetheghan wanakauna e vwatanji. Thɨ vakatha iyake kaiwae kaero ya thuwevao Leiban le vakathako wolaghɨye e ghen.

Ghino Loi iyava ya yomarana e ghen Betel e tɨne. Na gheko u liŋgiya bunama olivɨ e varɨ na u vamidi woyavwatata kaiwae. Na tembe u vakathava dagerawe na u kururu e ghino Loi womberegha. Mbaŋake u vivatha len bigibigina na u njogha e ghambanɨna iyava u rinawe.’”
Reitiyel na Leya thɨ gonjoghawe thɨŋa, “Thare the bigithan reghava ina ramameko e ghayayao tɨne ghime kaiwame?
Thare le vakathako weinda ghamɨnae ŋgoreiya eto gharɨgharɨniye ghinda? Kaiwae maa mbe i vakuneŋainda eŋge, ko iyemaeŋge kaero i ghanɨvao mani iya len kaiwoko une.
Emunjoru bigibigike wolaghɨye thiyake, iya Loi va i mban weya ramameko, kaero ghindawe na la ŋgamaŋgama kaiwanji. U vakatha budakaiya Loi i utugiyana e ghen.”

Kaero Jeikob i vivatha na i wareri i njogha weya ramae Kenan e thivathivaniye. I takoŋgiya thetheghanɨko na le bigibigiko wolaghɨye va le yakuyaku Padan Aram e tɨne na i mban vathavatha. Le ovo na le ŋgamaŋgama thɨ rakatha e kamel vwatanji na amalaghɨniye i takoŋgiya thetheghanɨko na i viva e ghamwanji.
Mbaŋa Leiban kaero i wa na ve tena sip vulivuliye wul kaiwae, e ghereiye amba Reitiyel i kaiva ŋgoloko mbe ghaloi vatavatadɨ. Iyako mbe ramaewe.
Jeikob i ravunyivunyi weya Leiban rara Aram na mava i utugiyawe le wareriko utuniye.
Iya kaiwae weiyaŋgiya le ovo, i vo bigiya le bigibigiko wolaghɨye. I lawa e walaghɨta laghɨye Yupreitis na i loŋgaŋa bobokulu thivathivaniye idae Giliyad.
Leiban i woreghamba weya Jeikob
Mbaŋa theghetoniye e tɨne Leiban amba i loŋwevaidi Jeikob kaero menda i vogha.
I vaŋguŋgiya le bodaboda ghɨmoghɨmoruko vavana na thɨ woreghamba weya Jeikob. Mbaŋa theghepirɨ e ghereiye i vuthavaleŋgi e bobokulu, Giliyad thivathivaniye ele valɨvaŋga.
Ko gougou eŋge ghenelolo e tɨne Loi i dage weya Leiban rara Aram iŋa, “Ya vanuwovɨrɨŋge. Thava ne u utu vatharɨ weya Jeikob.”
Jeikob i vatad le yoŋathowathowa e bobokulu vwatae Giliyad e tɨne. Na gheko Leiban i vuthavalewe. Weiyaŋgiya le wabwi thɨ vatad lenji yoŋathowathowa e valɨvaŋga regha evasiwanjiko.
Leiban i dage weya Jeikob iŋa, “Mendava u vakatha budakai? Mendava u ravunyivunyi e ghino na u vovaŋguŋgiya yawarumbuŋgu theunyiwo ŋgoreiya wanakau thɨ laweŋgi gaithɨ e tɨne.
Buda kaiwae mendava u ravunyivunyi e ghino na u vothuwole? Buda kaiwae maa mendava u dage e ghino, mbala valɨkaiwae ghino menda ya variyeŋga weiye warari, wothuwothu na thilo laiye?
Ma mendava u vatomwe e ghino na ya vandamo mwaewoŋgiya orumburumbuŋgu na otɨnatɨnanji. Emunjoru len vakathako maa weiye len renuwaŋa thovuye.
Elo vurɨgheghe na valɨkaiwae ma vakatha vuyowo e ghen, ko iyemaeŋge me gougou rama le Loi i vanuwovɨrɨŋgo, iŋa, ‘Ne u ndeutuŋa utu regha weiye len ghare gaithɨ Jeikob we.’
I thovuye eŋge kaero menda nuwanɨna nuwaiya u njogha e ghamban. Ko iyemaeŋge buda kaiwae mendava u lakaiva lo loiŋgike?”
Jeikob i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Va weiŋgu lo mararu kaiwae lo renuwaŋake va yaŋaeŋgeva mbwata ne u vothaŋaŋgo na u vaŋgu njoghaŋgiya oyawarumbuke e ghino. Iyake kaiwae va ya warerithuwole.

Ko iyemaeŋge thoŋgo u vaidiya the lolothan ina gheke mendava i mbana len loiŋgina, ne yaŋa na i mare. La bodaboda e maranji mbowo u tamwe ghanɨmbereghana. The bigi u vaidi ghenɨwe u mban.” Jeikob mava i ghareghare Reitiyel va i lakaiva Leiban le loiŋgiko.

Kaero Leiban ve tamwe Jeikob ele yoŋathowathowa na mbowo i wava we Leya le yoŋathowathowa na i wa weŋgiya le rakakaiwoma theunyiwoma, ko iyemaeŋge maa i vaidiya le loiŋgima. Amba i wava Reitiyel ele yoŋathowathowako.

Reitiyel kaero me mbanuwo ŋgoloko ghaloiŋgima na i bigimban e kamelɨko gharathatha lenji ghamba yaku, na mbe i yaku e vwatae mbaŋa ramae i ruwe. Mbaŋa Leiban i tamwe ghatharaŋa yoŋathowathowako tɨne, ma i vaidi bigi regha mun.

Reitiyel i dage weya ramae iŋa, “Wogiya laghɨye, thava gharen i gaithɨ wanaŋgo. Ma valɨkaiwaŋgu ya ndeghathɨ e maran; ya yaku e njamnjam.” Leiban me rovurɨgheghe e tamwe ko iyemaeŋge ma i vaidi mun le ŋgoloma ghaloiŋgi.
Jeikob ghare i gaithɨ iwaeŋge i dage weya Leiban iŋa, “Ko va ya vakatha vara the tharɨ? Va ya rake the mbaro na i vatomwe e ghen iya u tamwe ghatharaŋgoke?

Kaiwae kaero mo tamweghatharaŋa lo bigibigike wolaghɨye, na mo vaidiya the bigi i mena e len ŋgoloma tɨne? U woraŋgiya gheke e ghamwandake, na ghen na ghino la gharɨgharɨke thɨ thuwe na thɨ ghethe thaghewoke kaiwanda.

“Theghathegha hoiwo ya yaku weiŋgu ghen. Ya njimbukiki wagiyawe len sip na gout na lenji ghambɨ mbe i thovuye eŋge vara. Tembe ŋgoreiyeva ma mbaŋa regha ya unɨgha len gout ghɨmoruna regha wo thalavu kaiwae.

The mbaŋa thoŋgo thetheghan mbwanjam regha i mena thɨvatharɨ kaiwae, mbe womberegha vara ya vamboromboro iya thɨ vatharɨko iyako. Iyemaeŋge thoŋgo i yomara ŋgoreiyako, u vavothaŋaŋgo na ya vamodo budakaiya va i ghawe gougou o ghararaghɨye.
Yakuyakuke iyake va thɨ yomara e ghino elo njimbukiki weŋgiya len thetheghanɨko. Ghararaghɨye varae i tagavaŋaŋanyaŋgo na gougou njighɨnjighɨ kaiwae mbe ighɨviya iya eŋge e maraŋgu.

Theghathegha hoiwo e tɨne vambe inanŋgu vara elen ŋgolona ŋgoreiye narunɨna ghino. Theghathegha hoyaworo na umbovarɨ e tɨne ya kaiwo yawarumbuke theunyiwoke kaiwanji na theghathegha umbowona len thetheghanɨna weŋgi. Ko othembe lo kaiwo va ŋgoreiyako, u vɨvɨva modaŋgu mbaŋa lemoyo.

Thoŋgo rumbuŋgu Eibraham le Loi na Loiko iya bwebwe Aisake i kururukowe ma ina e ghino, emunjoru mbala menda u variye yathuŋgo kokowaŋgu. Ko iyemaeŋge Loi va i thuwe wovuyowoko na lo kaiwo vurɨghegheko kaiwan, iya kaiwae me gougou Loi i worawa ghan mbaro.”
Jeikob na Leiban thɨ vakatha lenji dagerawe

Leiban i thombeya Jeikob le utuutuko iŋa, “Wanakauke thiyake ghino lo ŋgaŋgaŋgi na tembe ŋgoreiyeva gamagaike thiyake ghino orumburumbuŋguŋgi na thetheghanɨke thiyake ghino lo thetheghan. Iya vara wolaghɨyeke u thuweŋgike mbe ghinowe eŋge. Iyemaeŋge e mbaŋake noroke ne ya vakatha budakai weŋgiya oyawarumbuŋguŋgike na gamagaike iyava thɨ ghambɨŋgike?
Nuwaŋguiya e mbaŋake iyake ghen na ghino ra vakatha dagerawe regha na Loi iye ghanda raghaghayawo e ghanda lughawoghawo.”
Kaero Jeikob i wo varɨ laghɨye regha na i vamidi na i tabo na nono, na i vanuwovɨrɨŋgi lenji dageraweko kaiwae.
Amba Jeikob i dage weŋgiya le bodabodako iŋa, “Hu mbanɨvatha varɨvarɨ na hu wabwi na i voro.” Mbaŋa kaero thɨ vakathavao, amba Leiban na Jeikob thiya yaku na regha na thiya ghanɨŋga.
Leiban i rena wabwiko idae Jega Sahaduta (vaŋa Aram gharumwaru “vanuwovɨrɨ ghawabwi”), na Jeikob i rena idae Galid (vaŋa Kenan gharumwaru “vanuwovɨrɨ ghawabwi”).
Leiban i dage weya Jeikob iŋa, “Varɨvarɨke ghawabwi iyake ne i vanuwovɨrɨinda dageraweke mara vakathake noroke.” Iya kaiwae Jeikob i rena idae Galid.
Vambe thɨ renɨva idae Mijɨpa, kaiwae Leiban va iŋa, “Loi mbe ghamberegha vara i njimbukikinda na ra renuwaŋakikiya dageraweke iyake mbaŋa ne ra iteta valɨvaŋgake iyake.

Thoŋgo ma u goru weŋgiya lo ŋgaŋgana theunyiwona, o thoŋgo u vaŋguŋgiva wanakau vavana weinjiyaŋgiya lo ŋgaŋgana, othembe ma lolo regha i utugiya weŋgo, wo u renuwaŋakiki eŋge Loi iye ghanda raghaghayawo e ghanda lughawoghawo.”
Leiban tembe i dage weva Jeikob iŋa, “Wo u thuwe, varɨvarɨ wabwima iyake na varɨma i ndeghathɨma iyake. Kaero mara vakathaŋgi e ghandalughawoghaweke.

Iya varɨvarɨke wabwike na iya i ndeghathɨke thiye ghandaraghaghayawo. Mane ya valaŋaniya wabwike na varɨke i ndeghathɨke na ya ghaona e len valɨvaŋgana na ya vakowanaŋge, na ghen tembe mane u valaŋaniyava wabwike na varɨke iya i ndeghathɨke na u mena e lo valɨvaŋgake na u vakowanaŋgo.

Orumburumbunda lenji loiŋgi tembene thɨ ghethe thoŋgo ra renuwaŋakiki na ra vikikighathɨgha iya dageraweke iyake ghautuutuke wolaghɨye: thiye Eibraham le Loi na Neiho le loi.” Kaero Jeikob i tholo weya Loi iya ramae Aisake i mararuke e idae.
I vakatha vowo gheko e ouko vwatae amba i kula vathaŋgiya le bodabodako na thɨ ghana ghanɨŋgako iyako weinji. Ghanɨŋgako e ghereiye mbowo thɨ ghenava gheko.
Mbaŋambaŋa vena Leiban i thuweiru i vandamoŋgiya orumburumbuyeko na oyawarumbuyeŋgima na i mwaewo weŋgi. Amba i wareri na i njogha e ghambae.
